caption: Choose the checkout XML file in the vault.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['junit-failure-notes']; for (const modal of [...p.dialogs]) modal.close(); p.pro.signOut(); p.choose('report'); const s = document.querySelector('.modal select'); s.value='JUnit Failure Notes/checkout.xml'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); return 'ok'; })()
after: (() => { const p=app.plugins.plugins['junit-failure-notes']; for (const modal of [...p.dialogs]) modal.close(); p.pro.signOut(); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Four test cases counted from child status elements.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['junit-failure-notes']; for (const modal of [...p.dialogs]) modal.close(); p.pro.signOut(); const f = await p.createReport('JUnit Failure Notes/checkout.xml', false, false); await app.workspace.getLeaf(false).setViewState({ type: 'markdown', state: {file: f.path, mode:'preview'} }); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Literal assertion text and case output inside a folded callout.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['junit-failure-notes']; for (const modal of [...p.dialogs]) modal.close(); p.pro.signOut(); const f = await p.createReport('JUnit Failure Notes/checkout.xml', false, false); await app.workspace.getLeaf(false).setViewState({ type: 'markdown', state: {file: f.path, mode:'preview'} }); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); document.querySelector('.workspace-leaf:not(.mod-hidden) .markdown-preview-view .callout[data-callout="failure"] .callout-title')?.click(); document.querySelector('.markdown-preview-view .callout[data-callout="failure"]')?.scrollIntoView({block:'start'}); return 'ok'; })()
